repo_meta_data.description: The open-source alternative to Granola. Records your calls on a Mac, transcribes them on your own machine, lets your own AI agent in the terminal (Claude Code, Codex or any other) follow and question a call while it runs, and saves the notes to your own tools. Also runs as a self-hosted transcription server.
